title: Same Words, Different Meanings: Semantic Polarization in Broadcast Media Language Forecasts Polarization on Social Media Discourse
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring semantic polarization and partisan divide in media discourse regarding social and political topics like racism, BLM, and climate change. While these topics have ethical dimensions, the research objective is to analyze linguistic polarization and media influence rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or ethical systems.
